items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I heard him play somewhere else... he used to play mostly with Sam Morgan I believe... that was George A. Boyd, I believe he was the roughest one

ctx.x: That before Big Eye played with him?

Yeah, before Big Eye. And I heard him play somewhere else, I can't think of it now, but he used to play mostly with Sam Morgan I believe. Yeah, he played with Sam Morgan. Because that's what I tell you, this rough kind of playing, that was George A. Boyd, I believe he was the roughest one and didn't know nothing about no music and could play the sweet clarinet. He was a big fella, kind of ugly, but he could play a clarinet. And he played with different good bands. All of them was good, but I mean at that time…
Wait, is that the old Halley Perseverance or something?
